about:
Founded in 1985 in Indianapolis, Indiana, EHOB, Inc. has spent four decades developing pressure injury prevention and safe patient handling solutions for healthcare facilities. The privately held company began with a focus on heel offloading and has expanded its portfolio through continuous collaboration with clinicians.

The company designs and manufactures heel offloading devices, patient positioning systems, and moisture management products aimed at reducing pressure injuries and improving staff safety. Its solutions are developed through direct dialogue with healthcare partners and are supported by clinical evidence gathered from trials conducted in hundreds of U.S. facilities between 2021 and 2025.

EHOB serves hospitals, long-term care centers, and other clinical settings where pressure injury prevention is a priority. Its customers include bedside clinicians, wound care teams, and facility administrators who rely on the company’s clinical support resources, protocols, and expert consultation to implement evidence-based prevention programs.

The company differentiates itself by combining 40 years of experience with data-driven product development, offering a customized experience for each facility. Its clinical resource center provides peer-reviewed research, outcome data, and educational materials to help healthcare professionals translate evidence into practice.
